# Laura Clarke Administrative Services

> Independent, private document concierge based in St. Catherine, Jamaica. We pre-audit paperwork against each agency's counter rules and file or collect documents at PICA, TAJ, RGD, JCF and ITA for clients in Jamaica and overseas (US, UK, Canada). We are not a government agency and are not affiliated with the Government of Jamaica. Government fees are paid to the agency and are separate from our service fee. Courier is charged separately and quoted by delivery address.

How to start: new clients send a request through the request page (https://documenthelpja.com/start), choosing the service. Each service page has an eligibility checklist to read first. If their document is not listed, or their case is unusual, they send a free inquiry first; Laura then says whether a paid consultation (J$5,000 in Jamaica or US$70 overseas) is needed. Quick questions are free on WhatsApp: +1 (876) 561-2614. Email: info@documenthelpja.com. Requirements and fees on this site were last checked October 2026. Free guides and kits are information only; our paid services are listed below with their fees.

## Services (Dedicated Pages)

- [Jamaican Passport Services](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-passport-services.html): A short eligibility check sorts each visitor. Adults who qualify get a digital renewal made for them (J$5,000 in Jamaica or US$70 overseas, plus PICA's fee; courier to the door, or collect at PICA in Jamaica). Everyone else (children's passports, first adult passports, renewals with a name change, lost, stolen or damaged passports, and other paper renewals) is offered a prep package (J$2,000 in Jamaica or US$30 overseas; J$4,000 or US$50 for lost, stolen or damaged): the form is filled in for them, with a checklist of what to carry. The applicant prints, signs, gets it notarized where needed, and attends PICA (or their embassy or consulate overseas) themselves.
- [TRN from Overseas](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-trn-application-overseas-diaspora.html): For the diaspora and non-nationals abroad. We complete the TRN form, check the notarised ID, submit in person at TAJ, and send the TRN letter by DHL (US$100 fee; TAJ charges no government fee; optional apostille US$100 plus the Ministry's apostille fee).
- [Driver's Licence Renewal](https://documenthelpja.com/drivers-licence-renewal.html): TRN check, Form F7 prepared for signing, and TAJ fee paid online (J$4,000 plus TAJ's fee: Class B J$5,400, Class C J$7,200). Road-ready the same day with the receipt; the driver collects the card at TAJ in person. Traffic ticket lookup is J$1,500, separate from the renewal. Replacements for lost or stolen licences are not offered.
- [Motor Vehicle Licence Renewal](https://documenthelpja.com/motor-vehicle-licence-renewal.html): Online registration renewal when fitness and insurance are valid, (J$4,000 plus TAJ's fee), or a fitness and renewal package when fitness has expired (J$5,000 plus TAJ's fees). Fitness fee pre-pay (J$1,500) and traffic ticket lookup and payment (J$1,500 per session) are also available on their own. The owner takes the vehicle to the ITA depot for inspection.
- [Jamaican Driving Abstract](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-driving-abstract.html): Retrieval of the official driving record for overseas licence exchanges, insurers and employers. Unpaid tickets show on the abstract, so clients can clear them first with a ticket lookup (J$1,500) or go ahead as is. Authorisation letter stamping, fee payment, collection and DHL dispatch (US$100 plus government fees and DHL; optional apostille US$100 plus the Ministry's apostille fee).
- [Jamaican Police Record](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-police-record.html): In Jamaica, we complete the online application, pay the JCF fee and book the fingerprinting appointment (J$5,000 plus JCF fee). Overseas, applicants with a Jamaican TRN are fingerprinted where they live and we submit and collect the certificate (US$100 plus the JCF fee; returned in the client's prepaid DHL envelope). Apostille is US$100 extra if needed, plus the Ministry's apostille fee.
- [Birth, Marriage & Death Certificates (RGD)](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-rgd-certificates.html): Clients with the certificate or its entry number, and correct details, can order a certified copy (J$3,000 in Jamaica or US$30 overseas, plus the RGD fee: J$4,000 regular or J$6,000 express). Without them, a record search comes first (J$5,000 or US$70, plus the RGD's J$1,000 per decade searched). Records with errors need a consultation first (J$5,000 or US$70). Delivery by DHL (quoted and added), or collection in person in Jamaica.
- Apostille (for documents going overseas; an add-on to the services above, such as RGD certificates, police records, driving abstracts and TRN letters): we take the document to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade for its apostille (US$100 per document, added on top of the service fee, covering the trips, stamp duty and lodging; the Ministry's apostille fee and courier are extra). Note: some countries, such as Nigeria, are not party to the Apostille Convention and need legalisation instead.
- [Free Kits & Checklists](https://documenthelpja.com/free-kits): Free printable PDFs to download, no sign-up: Self-Employed Tax Survival Kit, Tax Backlog Recovery Guide and H-2B Application Toolkit.
- [Request a service](https://documenthelpja.com/start): Choose a service (or a consultation, when Laura has said one is needed), give your details and accept the terms. Laura replies by WhatsApp or email.
- [Digital Business Contact Card](https://documenthelpja.com/card.html): Instant vCard download and WhatsApp connection.

## Guides & Advisory

- [US visitor visa (B1/B2) from Jamaica](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-us-visitor-visa-guide): The DS-160 form, the visa fee, interview day in Kingston and agency red flags. Information only; we do not complete visa applications.
- [H-2B work placement from Jamaica](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-h2b-work-visa-guide): How seasonal U.S. work visas operate, the documents needed, how to check an agency is licensed with the Ministry of Labour, questions to ask and scam red flags, with a free printable toolkit. Information only; we do not recruit or place workers.
- [Birth, marriage and death certificates (RGD) guide](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-rgd-certificates-guide): Ordering a certified copy, entry numbers, record searches and ordering from overseas.
- [PICA card payment failed](https://documenthelpja.com/pica-card-payment-failed): Why overseas cards are declined on the PICA passport renewal portal, the draft lock, and the 4-step fix.
- [Jamaican police record overview](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-police-record-guide): Which route fits you (in Jamaica, overseas, for a foreign government, name changed), JCF fees and speeds, what the Criminal Records Office checks and common mistakes. Application prep and the overseas proxy are paid services: https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-police-record.html
- [Jamaican driver's licence overview](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-drivers-license-renewal-guide): Which licence lane fits you (Class B, Class C, over 70, overseas, lost or stolen), same-day vs drop-off offices, the 60-day receipt rule and what TAJ checks. Renewal done for you is a paid service: https://documenthelpja.com/drivers-licence-renewal.html
- [TRN with only a birth certificate](https://documenthelpja.com/trn-without-photo-id): The certified photo and declaration route for adults without photo ID, TRNs for children, and applying from overseas.
- [Jamaican passport overview](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-passport-guide): Which passport lane fits you (new, renewal, replacement, child, overseas), speed options, what PICA checks and where applications get stuck. Step-by-step help is a paid service: https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-passport-services.html
- [Citizenship by descent through a Jamaican parent](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-citizenship-by-descent): Who qualifies and the documents PICA requires to prove lineage. For applicants overseas only, a paid consultation (US$70) walks them through each step with a written guide and checklist; they submit the application themselves. They tell us about their situation first, and we say whether a consultation is needed before they pay anything.
- [Motor vehicle licence overview](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-motor-vehicle-licence-guide): What has to be in place (insurance, fitness, title), fees by engine size, what TAJ checks, and renewing online instead of at the tax office. Online renewal done for you is a paid service: https://documenthelpja.com/motor-vehicle-licence-renewal.html
- [Learner's Permit Complete Step-by-Step Guide](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-learners-permit-guide.html): Form H3A checklist, free ITA Road Code Test booking, J$1,800 TAJ fee, and lost permit replacement (also J$1,800).
- [Self-employed in Jamaica, Episode 1: S04 basics](https://documenthelpja.com/self-employed-s04-tax-guide): Who has to file, what the S04 and S04a are, the March 15 deadline and quarterly payment dates, with the free Self-Employed Tax Survival Kit to download. Information only; we do not prepare or file tax returns.
- [Episode 2: The self-employed NIS minimum](https://documenthelpja.com/self-employed-nis-minimum-jamaica): Why a nil S04 still carries about J$13,000 a year in NIS (6% of J$216,666.67), paid J$3,250 a quarter.
- [Episode 3: Traps that grow a TAJ bill](https://documenthelpja.com/self-employed-tax-traps-jamaica): Late-filing penalties, best judgement assessments, interest on missed quarters, NIS gaps and the TCC blockade, and how to catch up.
- [NIS record gaps, voluntary contributions and pensions](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-nis-guide): Closing contribution gaps and avoiding one-off grant traps.
- [C5 travel form and barrel clearance](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-c5-travel-form): Avoid wharf traps and personal effects declaration errors. Information only; we do not offer customs clearance.
